summary: Marshall demanded immediate passage of a $14 billion standalone aid package for Israel on the Senate floor in November 2023, calling Hamas an 'Army of Terror.' In May 2024 he told Fox Business it was 'not the time or place' for the U.S. to accept Palestinian refugees from Gaza. In April 2026 he voted against a Senate war-powers resolution requiring withdrawal of U.S. forces from the Iran conflict.
